# Rules

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A rule's namespace is the preset that turns it on: `stimulus/...` comes with
`/stimulus`, `browser/...` with `/browser`, and so on. A rule with no namespace
comes with `/base`.

Each rule links to its source, where a header comment explains what it is for and
why it exists.

| Rule | Preset | Fix | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`boolean-naming`](../src/rules/boolean-naming.js) | `/base` |  | Require boolean-returning methods to read as predicates (is/has prefix or a verb) |
| [`collapse-multi-line`](../src/rules/collapse-multi-line.js) | `/base` | yes | Collapse multi-line lists (params, args, objects, arrays, imports) when they fit on one line |
| [`compact-guard-clause`](../src/rules/compact-guard-clause.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer compact single-line guard clauses when they fit on one line |
| [`constant-naming`](../src/rules/constant-naming.js) | `/base` | yes | Require SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE for module-level and static literal constants |
| [`declarative-method-naming`](../src/rules/declarative-method-naming.js) | `/base` |  | Name value-returning methods declaratively, not for the imperative action |
| [`inline-memoized-computation`](../src/rules/inline-memoized-computation.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow memoization that delegates to another no-argument private method |
| [`max-bare-returns`](../src/rules/max-bare-returns.js) | `/base` |  | Limit bare `return` (valueless) statements per function |
| [`max-exported-classes`](../src/rules/max-exported-classes.js) | `/base` |  | Allow at most one exported class per file; internal classes are unlimited |
| [`max-field-assignments`](../src/rules/max-field-assignments.js) | `/base` |  | Limit plain instance-field assignments in a private method |
| [`max-local-variables`](../src/rules/max-local-variables.js) | `/base` |  | Limit local variable declarations per function; extract methods instead |
| [`max-logical-operators-per-condition`](../src/rules/max-logical-operators-per-condition.js) | `/base` |  | Limit logical operators in conditions; extract complex predicates |
| [`max-optional-chain-depth`](../src/rules/max-optional-chain-depth.js) | `/base` |  | Limit optional-chain depth (`a?.b?.c?.d`) |
| [`max-validation-guards-per-function`](../src/rules/max-validation-guards-per-function.js) | `/base` |  | Limit validation guards (returning null/false/undefined) at the start of a function |
| [`no-anemic-delegation`](../src/rules/no-anemic-delegation.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow functions or private methods that only delegate to a freshly built object |
| [`no-anemic-record`](../src/rules/no-anemic-record.js) | `/base` |  | Detect an object literal of several fields read across functions; prefer a class |
| [`no-boolean-handler-chain`](../src/rules/no-boolean-handler-chain.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow boolean-returning handler chains (`a() || b() || c()`) |
| [`no-data-clump`](../src/rules/no-data-clump.js) | `/base` |  | Detect argument names that travel together across functions; prefer a class holding them |
| [`no-effectful-bare-return`](../src/rules/no-effectful-bare-return.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow a bare `return` at the end of a branch that first does other work |
| [`no-handler-prefix`](../src/rules/no-handler-prefix.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow the `handle` name prefix; name for the action, not the event |
| [`no-jsdoc`](../src/rules/no-jsdoc.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow JSDoc block comments |
| [`no-local-variable-return`](../src/rules/no-local-variable-return.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow returning a local variable as a function's last statement |
| [`no-manual-accumulation`](../src/rules/no-manual-accumulation.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer declarative array/object/Map building over manual loop or forEach accumulation |
| [`no-method-named-call`](../src/rules/no-method-named-call.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow defining a method or function named `call` |
| [`no-mid-function-returns`](../src/rules/no-mid-function-returns.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow `return`/`throw` outside the leading guard zone or final statement |
| [`no-mixed-memoization`](../src/rules/no-mixed-memoization.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow mixing memoization with other statements in the same method |
| [`no-mutable-module-scope`](../src/rules/no-mutable-module-scope.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow `let`/`var` declarations at module scope |
| [`no-padded-braces`](../src/rules/no-padded-braces.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow blank lines after `{` or before `}` in imports, exports, objects, and destructuring |
| [`no-redundant-bind-after-arrow`](../src/rules/no-redundant-bind-after-arrow.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow `this.foo.bind(this)` when `foo` is an arrow class field |
| [`no-redundant-trailing-return`](../src/rules/no-redundant-trailing-return.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow trailing `return null/undefined` in side-effect-only functions |
| [`no-redundant-wrapper-method`](../src/rules/no-redundant-wrapper-method.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow private methods or getters that only forward to another call |
| [`no-relative-imports`](../src/rules/no-relative-imports.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow relative imports when an equivalent bare import resolves |
| [`no-section-divider-comments`](../src/rules/no-section-divider-comments.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow ASCII-art section divider comments |
| [`no-typographic-clutter`](../src/rules/no-typographic-clutter.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow typographic clutter (smart quotes, en/em dash, arrows, bullets, zero-width) |
| [`padding-after-guard-clause`](../src/rules/padding-after-guard-clause.js) | `/base` | yes | Require a blank line after guard clauses |
| [`prefer-arrow-handler-field`](../src/rules/prefer-arrow-handler-field.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer arrow class fields over `this.foo = this.foo.bind(this)` |
| [`prefer-class-for-state`](../src/rules/prefer-class-for-state.js) | `/base` |  | Detect a value threaded through many functions; prefer a class holding it as state |
| [`prefer-find-over-loop`](../src/rules/prefer-find-over-loop.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer `.find()`/`.some()` over a `for...of` that conditionally returns a value |
| [`prefer-flat-tests`](../src/rules/prefer-flat-tests.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow `describe` and `it` blocks in favor of flat `test` calls |
| [`prefer-for-each`](../src/rules/prefer-for-each.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer `.forEach()` over `for...of` for pure array iteration |
| [`prefer-function-over-stateless-method`](../src/rules/prefer-function-over-stateless-method.js) | `/base` |  | Disallow private methods that never use `this`; make them module-level functions |
| [`prefer-getter`](../src/rules/prefer-getter.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer a getter over a parameterless method that only returns a value |
| [`prefer-getter-over-local`](../src/rules/prefer-getter-over-local.js) | `/base` |  | Prefer a memoized getter over a local that reuses class state in a class method |
| [`prefer-positive-wrap`](../src/rules/prefer-positive-wrap.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer wrapping a happy path positively over a leading negative guard |
| [`prefer-switch-over-if-chain`](../src/rules/prefer-switch-over-if-chain.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer `switch` over `if/else if` chains comparing the same subject |
| [`prefer-tail-condition`](../src/rules/prefer-tail-condition.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer `if (!condition) return X` over `if (condition) return; return X` at the tail of a block |
| [`prefer-ternary-return`](../src/rules/prefer-ternary-return.js) | `/base` | yes | Prefer a single return expression over `if (condition) return X; return Y` |
| [`reflow-comments`](../src/rules/reflow-comments.js) | `/base` | yes | Fill a comment wrapped short of the max width when the break falls mid-sentence |
| [`step-down-methods`](../src/rules/step-down-methods.js) | `/base` | yes | Order methods within each class group top-down: a caller before its callees |
| [`step-down-top-level`](../src/rules/step-down-top-level.js) | `/base` | yes | Order top-level functions and classes top-down: callers before callees, exported first |
| [`top-level-constants-first`](../src/rules/top-level-constants-first.js) | `/base` | yes | Group module-level const declarations at the top, before functions and classes |
| [`unnecessary-local-variable`](../src/rules/unnecessary-local-variable.js) | `/base` | yes | Disallow a local variable that aliases a call used only once |
| [`vertical-spacing`](../src/rules/vertical-spacing.js) | `/base` | yes | Surround code with blank lines; group same-category data without them |
| [`browser/html-element-suffix`](../src/rules/browser/html-element-suffix.js) | `/browser` |  | Require classes extending HTMLElement to end in `Element` |
| [`browser/no-class-selector`](../src/rules/browser/no-class-selector.js) | `/browser` |  | Disallow selecting DOM nodes by CSS class; classes style, they do not carry state |
| [`browser/prefer-reflected-aria-properties`](../src/rules/browser/prefer-reflected-aria-properties.js) | `/browser` | yes | Prefer reflected ARIA properties over `aria-*` attribute calls |
| [`browser/query-selector-suffix`](../src/rules/browser/query-selector-suffix.js) | `/browser` |  | Require getters returning querySelector(All) results to end in Element/Elements |
| [`rails/no-csrf-token-access`](../src/rules/rails/no-csrf-token-access.js) | `/rails` |  | Disallow reading the CSRF token from the meta tag or an X-CSRF-Token header |
| [`stimulus/action-naming`](../src/rules/stimulus/action-naming.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Disallow the `on` prefix on Stimulus controller actions |
| [`stimulus/controller-shape`](../src/rules/stimulus/controller-shape.js) | `/stimulus` | yes | Enforce Stimulus controller member order |
| [`stimulus/no-imperative-event-listener`](../src/rules/stimulus/no-imperative-event-listener.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Disallow `addEventListener` in Stimulus controllers; use `data-action` in HTML |
| [`stimulus/no-instance-state-assignment`](../src/rules/stimulus/no-instance-state-assignment.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Disallow public `this.foo = ...` in Stimulus controllers; use `#private` or declare a value |
| [`stimulus/no-manual-static-attribute-query`](../src/rules/stimulus/no-manual-static-attribute-query.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Disallow querying Stimulus wiring attributes by hand |
| [`stimulus/prefer-dispatch`](../src/rules/stimulus/prefer-dispatch.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Prefer `this.dispatch(...)` over `this.element.dispatchEvent(...)` in Stimulus controllers |
| [`stimulus/static-config-keys-camelcase`](../src/rules/stimulus/static-config-keys-camelcase.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Enforce camelCase keys in Stimulus static targets/classes/values/outlets |
| [`stimulus/use-has-target-getter`](../src/rules/stimulus/use-has-target-getter.js) | `/stimulus` |  | Prefer the `hasFooTarget` getter over comparing `this.fooTargets.length` |
| [`turbo/no-render-stream-message`](../src/rules/turbo/no-render-stream-message.js) | `/turbo` |  | Disallow Turbo.renderStreamMessage; let the server drive Turbo Streams |
| [`turbo/no-stream-accept-header`](../src/rules/turbo/no-stream-accept-header.js) | `/turbo` |  | Disallow requesting Turbo Streams from JS via the Accept header |
